snippet.title: Why Truth Is Disappearing… and Why It Matters More Than Ever
snippet.description:
What does it actually look like to finish your life well? In this episode of the Jubilee Church Podcast, Bryan and Jordan reflect on the life and impact of Confluence pastor Rhys Scott and how his example connects deeply to Paul’s words in Acts 20. Their conversation moves beyond theory into the kind of life that is marked by faithfulness, endurance, and a clear sense of calling.

As they wrestle with what it takes to stay the course, the discussion turns personal; exploring the habits, convictions, and decisions that shape a life that finishes strong. Along the way, they unpack how truth plays a central role in truly knowing God and others, and why clarity around truth matters more than ever in a culture where it is often distorted.

Jordan shares some of his own experiences growing in confidence when it comes to speaking truth, especially with those who don’t yet believe. The episode closes by addressing a pressing question: what should concern us most about the way truth is being reshaped in our world today, and how do we respond as followers of Jesus?

This is a thoughtful and challenging conversation for anyone who wants their life to count, not just for now, but for the long run.
